tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i nying khu 'chi ba med pa'i go 'phang sbyin pa zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ /sku gsum mnga' bdag 'dren pa mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /lnga bdor tha mal tshul gyi 'gro ba'i don/ /mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes rnams kyi/ /bka' drin dran no byang chub bar du skyongs/ /'dir dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zab cing rgya che ba/ lam zab bla mchod/ lam 'bras phyag mchod/ bde mchog bla mchod sogs gzhung bzang la mang ba mchis kyang / tshig tshogs blo la 'dzin dka' bar brten/ 'dir snying po bsdus pa brjod na 'di ltar spyi dang bye brag gi rten dang / yon chab spos mar me lha bshos sogs mchod pa gang rgyas dang / maṇḍal so bdun ma rab gser zangs las grub pa dngos su yod pa'am/ med kyang me tog gi tshom bu bshams/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril sogs dang maṇḍal grangs mang du bsog na/ de'i chos la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa thams cad sta gon bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ gnas yo byin rlabs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyai rdor bzhin bya/ bla ma bskyed chog rang la bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla mas gtso byas bla ma chos 'brel thob tshad skyabs gnas kun 'dus rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar kyai rdor yab yum du bsgom pa ste/ chos dbyings 'od gsal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sogs nas/ nor lha'i tshogs rnams dges bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ de nas nus na/ gang drin ma yongs rdzogs sam/ mi nus na shlo ka gcig dang / 'dren mchog bla ma kun gyi ngo bo nyid sogs dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bstod pa gang shes dang / skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che sogs dang /

shes na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya/ mi shes na gong gi de tsam gyi chog mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ chu bzhi byed na zhabs bsil phal cher sogs dang / chu gnyis byed na mchod yon phal cher sogs bya/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra sogs kyi sprul te/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun dang kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyis 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ de nas maṇḍal 'bul/ mthar shes na gang gi mchod rdzas sogs bya/ slar yang sdig bshags la nan tan byed na/ thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig steng du/ /tshe 'dir myur du dmyal bar skye nges kyi/ /las ngan du ma bsags kyang mi 'gyod pa'i/ /khrel 'das sdig ldan bdag la skyabs tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi sdom pa blang bar bsam la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas nus na bdag ni thog med dus nas su sogs nas/ ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub pa shog gi bar byed pa yin kyang / de tsam mi nus na/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'i bar ram/ de'ang ma grub na phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs shlo ka gcig de nas zhen pa spang ba ni/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi sogs nas byang chub sems 'byongs sangs rgyas thob gyur cig gi bar bya/ de nas phyogs bcu dus gsum mas gsol ba btab la/ dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni/ rje btsun mchog gi mtha' skor bzhugs pa yi/ /sogs nas ngo bo nyid skur gyur gyi bar bya/ bla ma yab yum rang la bstims te/ gnas lugs kyi ngang la ci nus mnyam par bzhag sangs rgyas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma sogs dang / thos pa rgya mtsho ma/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs gang shes bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dam pa gong ma'i bla ma mchod chog gi yi ge bzang la mang ba bzhugs kyang / khyer bde nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes bla ma rin po che sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/

bya bral bas sangs rgyas phun tshogs bsgrigs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs mchog ni/ /sems nyid lhan skyes rtogs la rag /de yang bla ma'i byin rlabs la/ /rag las chos 'di'i gnad don no// //sarba maṅga laṃ/ yang zhus/ dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i nying khu/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
